question: Suppose \(f\) is a differentiable and increasing function on \([0,1]\) such that \(f(0)<0<f(1)\). Let \(F(t)=\displaystyle\int_0^t f(x)\,dx\). Then

options.C: \(F\) has a unique maximum in the open interval \((0,1)\)
options.D: \(F\) has a unique minimum in the open interval \((0,1)\).
